title: 天皇賞（春）の後に・どうして？

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Tokai Teio loses against Mejiro McQueen, who declares that no matter how many times they race, Teio will never win.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Wanting to prove herself, Tokai Teio decides to race in the Japan Cup.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Several days later, Tokai Teio is training with all her might when Symboli Rudolf offers her some critical remarks.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She tells Teio that there is a big difference between her and McQueen. No matter how many times they race, Teio will never beat her.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Rudolf's statement throws Teio and her efforts to work toward the Japan Cup into a tailspin.
